name: Hawthorne Teen Center
what_you_do: Get homework help, SAT workshops, job training and field trips after school. In Fit For Gold, you can tutor or mentor young kids for paid work experience and high school credit.
who_can_apply: Ages 13 to 17. The center serves Hawthorne, Lawndale and El Segundo.
pay_detail: Center services are at no cost. Fit For Gold offers paid work experience. The rate is not stated.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The center has set weekly hours.
how_to_apply: Call (310) 970-7001 or visit 3901 W. El Segundo Blvd., Hawthorne. The pages do not list sign-up steps.
notes: Ask how to get a Fit For Gold spot, since the pages do not say how many there are.
